items.heading: Neither a Job Nor
items.text: Neither a job nor a degree builds financial security on its own. What builds it is a high-income skill portfolio: the right skill mix for you, visible proof you can do the work, the ability to communicate that work to an employer or client, a clear position in the market, a fit between the skill and how you actually like to work, and a financial plan that does not overspend to get there. Whichever path you pick from , keep building all six, not just the technical skill.
